items.text: Upstream adds schemathesis-tests, a top-level entry the fork's filter has no rule for, so Sync Upstream stops with UNKNOWN_TOP_LEVEL. Nothing else waits on it.

items.title: Add a rule for schemathesis-tests to .github/upstream-filter.yml, then dispatch sync.

confirm.title: Dismiss svc · sync halted?
confirm.body: It leaves the queue and the badge until its inputs change: a new head, run, failure or entry brings it back. The decision is kept in the rib's data dir; nothing is written to GitHub.
